title: Multi-Agent Protocol Schema
description: JSON Schema for the Multi-Agent Protocol (MAP) - a protocol for observing, coordinating, and routing messages within multi-agent AI systems

RequestId.description: Unique identifier for a request, used to correlate responses

MAPRequest.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request message in MAP

MAPResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response message in MAP

MAPNotification.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification message in MAP (no response expected)

ErrorCategory.description: Category of error for handling decisions

ParticipantId.description: Unique identifier for any participant (agent, client, system, gateway)

Meta.description: Vendor extension metadata. Implementations MUST NOT assume specific keys.

ParticipantType.description: Type of participant in the protocol

ParticipantCapabilities.description: Capabilities of a participant, grouped by category

canReceive.description: Can receive messages addressed to it

mail.description: Mail protocol capabilities for conversation/turn tracking

enabled.description: Whether mail is enabled (server response only)
Whether credential brokering is enabled (server response only)

canList.description: Can list available scopes via cred/list

canStatus.description: Can check broker status via cred/status

Participant.description: A participant in the MAP protocol

AgentState.description: State of an agent. Standard states are enumerated; custom states use 'x-' prefix.

IdentityType.description: How the identity was established. Standard types align with agent-iam providers; custom types use x- prefix.

IdentityVerificationStatus.description: How the server verified the agent's persistent identity. Servers MUST NOT set 'verified' unless cryptographic verification succeeded.

AgentIdentityProof.description: Proof binding a persistent identity to the current session

AgentPublicKeyJwk.description: JSON Web Key (JWK) representation of a public key (RFC 7517). For Ed25519: kty=OKP, crv=Ed25519, x=base64url-raw-key.

AgentEndorsement.description: Legacy authority endorsement vouching for an agent's identity

authorityPublicKey.description: The authority's public key (PEM) for verification

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over persistentId + publicKey + claim

AgentVerifiableCredential.description: W3C Verifiable Credential endorsement format (aligned with VC Data Model 2.0). Proof is computed over a JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization of the credential fields.

id.description: Issuer identifier (DID, URI, or plain string)

proofValue.description: base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over JCS-canonicalized payload

Endorsement.description: An endorsement can be either the legacy AgentEndorsement format or a W3C VerifiableCredential. Discriminate by checking for type: VerifiableCredential.

AgentPersistentIdentity.description: Persistent identity for an agent that survives across sessions and connections. persistentId formats: did:key:z6Mk... (keypair), platform:uuid (platform), spiffe://domain/path (attested), did:web:domain:path (decentralized).

persistentId.description: Stable identifier across sessions (DID, SPIFFE URI, or platform identifier)

publicKey.description: Public key for self-certifying verification (PEM format)

Agent.description: An agent in the multi-agent system

AgentEnvironment.description: Compute environment information for an agent. Category names are normative; field conventions within categories are documented separately.

ScopeAddress.description: Address all agents in a scope

RoleAddress.description: Address agents by role, optionally within a scope

HierarchicalAddress.description: Address relative to sender in hierarchy

BroadcastAddress.description: Address all agents in the system

ParticipantAddress.description: Address any participant by ID or category

FederatedAddress.description: Address an agent in a federated system

mail.description: Mail turn tracking metadata. When present on map/send, an intercepted turn is recorded.

Message.description: A message in the multi-agent system

payload.description: Message payload - structure depends on use case

ScopeVisibility.description: Who can see the scope exists and its members

MessageVisibility.description: Who can see messages sent to this scope

SendPolicy.description: Who can send messages to this scope

causedBy.description: IDs of events that caused this one (causal ordering)

roles.description: Only events from agents with these roles

replayFrom.description: Replay missed events from this point

ConnectRequest.description: Connect to the MAP system and negotiate capabilities

DisconnectRequest.description: Gracefully disconnect from the MAP system

capabilityId.description: Filter by structured capability ID from capabilityDescriptor

tags.description: Filter by semantic tags from capabilityDescriptor

accepts.description: Filter by accepted content type from capabilityDescriptor (MIME type)

AgentsGetRequest.description: Get details for a single agent

SendRequest.description: Send a message to an address

delivered.description: Participants the message was delivered to

AgentsRegisterRequest.description: Register a new agent in the system

resumePersistentIdentity.description: When true and persistentIdentity is provided, attempt to resume a previously orphaned agent with the same persistentId

resumed.description: Whether this registration resumed a previous agent via persistent identity

resumedFrom.description: Context about the resumed agent (only present when resumed is true)

AgentsSpawnRequest.description: Register agent and assign initial task atomically

resumePersistentIdentity.description: When true and persistentIdentity is provided, attempt to resume a previously orphaned agent with the same persistentId

requestedScopes.description: Scopes to request for the delegated credential (defaults to parent's scopes)

ttlMinutes.description: TTL in minutes for the delegated credential

delegatedCredentials.description: Credentials delegated to the spawned child agent (when auth provider supports delegation)

method.description: Auth method for the delegated credential

env.description: Environment variables for the child agent

AgentsUnregisterRequest.description: Remove an agent from the system

ScopesGetRequest.description: Get details for a single scope

ScopesJoinRequest.description: Add an agent to a scope

ScopesLeaveRequest.description: Remove an agent from a scope

InjectRequest.description: Inject context into a running agent (steering)

FederationConnectRequest.description: Connect to a peer MAP system. Supports single-request auth: include auth inline to complete federation handshake in one round-trip.

oneOf.description: Standard federation auth (bearer, api-key, mtls, etc.)

authContext.description: Additional auth context for single-request federation auth

exposure.description: Which resources the connecting system exposes

FederationConnectResponse.description: Response to map/federation/connect. When single-request auth succeeds, includes sessionId and principal. When auth fails or is required, includes authRequired with supported methods and challenge.

sessionId.description: Session ID assigned on successful auth

authRequired.description: Auth negotiation data (when auth is required or failed)

challenge.description: Challenge nonce for proof-based auth methods

required.description: Whether authentication is required to proceed

FederationRouteRequest.description: Route a message to a federated system

ParticipantRole.description: Role of a participant within a conversation

TurnStatus.description: Status of a turn's content lifecycle

TurnVisibility.description: Visibility of a turn within a conversation

ConversationPermissions.description: Permissions for a participant within a conversation

Conversation.description: A conversation - container for tracking related interactions

ConversationParticipant.description: A participant in a conversation with role and permissions

Turn.description: A turn - the atomic unit of conversation

contentType.description: Content type: text, data, event, reference, or x-* custom

content.description: Content payload - shape determined by contentType

Thread.description: A thread within a conversation for focused discussion

MailMessageMeta.description: Mail metadata for map/send turn tracking

MailSubscriptionFilter.description: Mail-specific subscription filter for conversation events

MailInviteRequest.description: Invite a participant to a conversation

MailTurnRequest.description: Record a turn in a conversation

MailThreadCreateRequest.description: Create a thread within a conversation

MailSummaryRequest.description: Get or generate a conversation summary

MailReplayRequest.description: Replay conversation turns from a point

CredGetRequest.description: Request a short-lived credential for a scope and resource

CredListRequest.description: List available scopes for the authenticated token

agentId.description: Agent ID from the authenticated token

CredStatusRequest.description: Check credential broker status and available providers

WorkspaceSearchRequest.description: Search for files matching a query in an agent's workspace

cwd.description: Subdirectory to search within (relative to workspace root)

WorkspaceListRequest.description: List files in a directory of an agent's workspace

directory.description: Directory to list (relative to workspace root, default '.')

WorkspaceReadRequest.description: Read file contents from an agent's workspace

agentId.description: Agent whose workspace to read from

path.description: File path relative to workspace root

WorkspaceFileResult.description: A file or directory entry in a workspace

size.description: File size in bytes (undefined for directories)

mime.description: MIME type guess based on extension

MAPAgentCapabilityDescriptor.description: Structured capability descriptor for rich agent discovery

version.description: Semantic version of the capability descriptor

MAPCapabilityDeclaration.description: A single capability declared by an agent

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for the content

DIDDocument.description: W3C DID Document for did:wba method

DIDVerificationMethod.description: A verification method in a DID Document

DIDService.description: A service endpoint in a DID Document

jws.description: JWS compact serialization of the proof signature

did.description: The DID of the authenticating system

MAPTaskStatus.description: Standard task status values. Implementations may use meta for richer states.

MAPTask.description: A task in the MAP system. Intentionally minimal — providers use the meta field for implementation-specific data.

assignee.description: Agent this task is assigned to (null = unassigned)

task.description: Task data. If id is omitted, the server generates one.

TasksAssignRequest.description: Assign a task to an agent
